title: Field
description: A named, typed data element declared in the physical structure of a persisted collection, whose value is stored for each record. Covers a SQL column, document field or path, hash field, wide-column column, time-series tag or field, vector or metadata field, graph property, and search-engine mapping property. Use Collection instead when the symbol declares the container of records (table, collection, bucket, measurement, node label) rather than one named element inside it. Use Index instead when the symbol declares a lookup structure over one or more existing fields (CREATE INDEX, createIndex, mapping index option) rather than the stored element itself. Use ValidationRule instead when the symbol is a separately declared constraint (PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, CHECK, UNIQUE, JSON Schema required list) that restricts field values, rather than the field declaration. Use View instead when the column appears only in a derived query or projection (SELECT list of a view, continuous aggregate) and is not stored in a base collection.

dataType.description: Data type of this field. Interpretation is paradigm-specific: SQL types (VARCHAR, INTEGER, TIMESTAMP), BSON types (String, ObjectId, Document), Elasticsearch mapping types (keyword, text, dense_vector), or any engine-native type name.

nullable.description: Whether the store accepts an absent or null value for this field. Set false when the declaration carries NOT NULL, required: true, or an equivalent, and true when nulls or missing paths are explicitly allowed.

defaultValue.description: The literal or expression the store assigns when a write omits this field, recorded as written in the source (e.g. '0', 'now()', 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP'). Set only when the default is declared in the storage schema, not when it is assigned in application code.

generated.description: Whether the field value is auto-generated. ALWAYS: value is always system-generated (SQL identity GENERATED ALWAYS, MongoDB auto _id, auto-increment). BY_DEFAULT: system-generated unless explicitly overridden (SQL GENERATED BY DEFAULT). NEVER: value must be user-provided.

fieldRole.description: Semantic role of this field within its collection. VALUE: regular data field. TAG: indexed metadata for filtering (time-series). TIMESTAMP: time-series time field. PARTITION_KEY: wide-column or distributed partition key component. CLUSTERING_KEY: wide-column clustering/sort key component. VECTOR: vector embedding field. METADATA: vector store metadata for filtering. LABEL: graph node label. PROPERTY: graph node or edge property.

vectorDimensions.description: Number of dimensions for vector fields. Only applicable when fieldRole is VECTOR.

distanceMetric.description: Distance metric for vector similarity search. COSINE: angular similarity. EUCLIDEAN: L2 distance. DOT_PRODUCT: inner product similarity. MANHATTAN: L1 distance. Only applicable when fieldRole is VECTOR.

analyzer.description: Text analyzer for search engine fields (e.g., 'standard', 'english', 'keyword', 'whitespace'). Controls tokenization and normalization. Only applicable for search engine paradigm.

nested.description: Whether this field contains nested or embedded documents. Relevant for document stores (MongoDB embedded documents) and search engines (Elasticsearch nested type).

x-source-reference.description: Source code reference using OpenAPI x- extension pattern.

x-dr-evidence: a column clause inside CREATE TABLE or ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN in a migration script (e.g. 'email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL')
an ORM-mapped attribute such as a JPA @Column field, SQLAlchemy Column(...), Django models.CharField, or Prisma model field line
an entry under a document or search schema definition, such as a Mongoose schema path, a MongoDB $jsonSchema property, or an Elasticsearch mappings.properties key with a type
